comments.author: Nekos
comments.body:
The companies TheEliteFew and TavernHoppers have 6 gems and gold and silver.RoyalCompany also have guild to change Jobs.

TheEliteFew is in Florida below the North America South-East Coast land.
TavernHoppers is next to North America East Coast land.

The gems they sell are tourmaline, emerald, garnet, agate, peridot and cristal.

Formula Gems Quantity in both = 62 + 32 * jewellry level
Formula Metal quantity in both = 21 + 8 * metal level

They sell almost as metal as Veracruz that sell with the formula
10 + 9 * metal level.
